title: His King trombone
summary: The first horn cost $3 at a pawn shop; his current King is some 47 years old and was refurbished once.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Cornet or trumpet: choosing and owning horns

blocks.x: Yeah. Can you tell me about your horn? What kind of a horn do you use now? What make is it and how big a...

Well, the first horn I had I bought for $3 in the hawk shop. And then I got this thing. This thing is about... I had it overhauled once. I sent it back to King. It's the King H.N. White in Cleveland. I sent it back once and the guy knew me. He says, where'd you get this horn, Bruno? It's from Methuselah? It was all beat up. But they fixed it up good and they lacquered it.
Yeah, it's about... How old is it? Oh, about... 40... 47 years.
